Looks like yogurt in a ~15 cm bowl; the mound is about 9 cm across. That puts the serving at roughly 150 g. Plain yogurt at around 60–100 kcal per 100 g suggests about 120 kcal; if it's sour cream or Greek yogurt it would be higher. I settled on about 130 kcal.
